title: Royal Canadian Regiment Museum

services.name: Virtual Exhibitions
services.desc: The title of this exhibition was partially borrowed from Robert Shipley, one of the artists who travelled to the Mediterranean island to observe the Canadian presence during UNFICYP deployments. Featuring mainly landscapes, by Robert Shipley and other artists, this exhibition also brings forward some of the faces that lived and worked in Cyprus between 1966 and 1985, during rotations of SNOWGOOSE, as the operation was known by the Canadian military. This exhibition was open to the public between 17 July and 22 September 2024 at The Royal Canadian Regiment Museum.
